affected.note: 21,945 records in data files plus 226,392 records in stored emails (students, staff and outside parties), as possibly stored on the stolen laptop; grade data of 889 students was also on it. The PC had no password set and taking the data off campus was not authorized. No leak damage was confirmed.

summary.en: Kanazawa University said a faculty member's bag containing a laptop was stolen during a business trip to Lausanne, Switzerland, on 2020-02-29. The laptop, which had no password protection, may have held about 248,000 records of students, staff and outside parties, including names, addresses, email addresses, photos and grades.
summary.ja: 金沢大学は、教員が2020年2月29日に出張先のスイス・ローザンヌでノートパソコンの入った鞄を盗まれたと公表した。パスワードが設定されていなかったパソコンには、学生や教職員、学外関係者の氏名、住所、メールアドレス、顔写真、成績など約24万8,000件の個人情報が保存されていた可能性がある。
